# TUIOS model-facing pane tools — implementation notes

## Scope delivered

One new writer file, plus one new focused test file:

- `src/tools/tuios-tools.ts` (new) — `registerTuiosTools(pi, store, runtime, hooks?)`
- `test/tuios-tools.test.ts` (new) — 32 deterministic tests against a scripted runtime

No existing file, runtime module, lifecycle, index, plan or doc was edited by me.
(`src/lifecycle.ts` shows as modified in the working tree and `src/tools/tuios-revive.ts` /
`src/tools/tuios-run.ts` are present as untracked — those are the parent/sibling writers, not me.)

## Registered tools

Same names, parameters and core result fields as the Herdr tools in
`spawn.ts`, `panes.ts`, `pane-read.ts`, `cleanup-panes.ts`, `tab-create.ts`, `tab-close.ts`:

| Tool | Herdr concern it replaces | TUIOS surface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `spawn_worker` | split + rename + run + wait | `new-window` with argv `command`, then `wait-for agent-state` |
| `picode_panes` | snapshot survey | `refresh()` → panes grouped by workspace |
| `picode_pane_read` | `pane read` | `capture-pane` |
| `cleanup_panes` | `pane close` (targeted/bulk/dry-run/force) | `close-window` via `runtime.close` |
| `picode_tab_create` | `tab create` | claim workspace + `new-window` root + `set-workspace-name` |
| `picode_tab_close` | `tab close` | close allowed windows + `set-workspace-name ""` |

## Tool behaviour, exactly

### spawn_worker (coordinator-only)

1. Role validated with the same rule as `spawn.ts` (`^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$`, ≤32 chars) **before** any runtime call.
2. `runtime.refresh()`; target tab = `params.tab` or `runtime.tabId`.
3. Target tab resolved through `runtime.assertWritableTab(...)` — exact tab ID, must be inside this
   session (`tabNumber`), must exist (`tab`), must not be a user-owned ("don't close") workspace.
4. Reuse (default `reuse !== false`): only an **idle/done** window whose label role matches, in the
   **same workspace**, never `runtime.ownPane`. No cross-workspace reuse.
